metadata.title: Probate Process for Real Estate Agents & Investors: 12 Steps From Filing to Sale
metadata.author: Probate Mastery
metadata.shortDescription:
The probate process, explained for real estate agents and investors. All 12 steps from filing to the sale, and where the deals actually hide.

▶ Start the free Probate Mastery course (this video is Module 1):  FREE: www.probatemastery.com 🎯 Practice these conversations live in Scripts & Role Play, $27/month: https://courses.probatemastery.com/offers/cQhonGt7/checkout

This is the foundational training every probate-focused agent and investor needs: the full probate process, start to finish, in plain language. Bruce Hill walks the 12 steps across four phases (opening, administering, liquidating, and closing the estate) so you never freeze when a personal representative, an heir, or an attorney asks you a question.

You'll learn who actually holds signing authority, the difference between an executor and an administrator, how to read letters testamentary, the valuation mistake that hands a family a surprise step-up tax, which assets skip probate and what drags them back in, when a probate property can really be listed and closed, and how to read the court file to find your best opportunities.
